rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Keep fixed opening surge; suppress anticipatory steering only when image-estimated speed exceeds 45, otherwise retain the old preview action.
expected_success_endpoint: On consumed diagnostic 7040-7043, finish both 3:7040 and 3:7041 while preserving opening launch and valid actions; no fresh performance claim.
falsifier: Either 3:7040 or 3:7041 candidate nonfinish, lost opening acceleration, invalid action, ZIP mismatch, or resource breach.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Exact extracted ZIP comparison on the already consumed 12 cells 7040-7043, focused on 3:7040 and 3:7041 actual finish crossings.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local diagnostic only, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB, 1800 seconds, 2000 decisions/cell; new 7052-7055 tune remains closed until this gate.
